tools.name: read_report
tools.description: Read one of fifteen published market reports without signing in. Large responses return a field directory; select a path and page arrays. Never generates or emails a report.

tools.name: earnings_history
tools.description: Retained earnings events and sector × market-cap comparisons with provenance and coverage. For page > 1 reuse the snapshot returned on page 1. Comparisons are descriptive, not predictions.

tools.name: options_question
tools.description: Requires a SignalDock account connection. Expected move, near-money skew/activity or IV history for one equity or futures root. At most five provider operations. Skew/activity require expiration. Coverage is bounded, never whole-chain totals.

tools.name: research_company
tools.description: Requires a SignalDock account connection. Technical analysis, forecast, analyst estimates, earnings context, valuation or capital structure. Returns existing API coverage and missing-data warnings. A pending response is not a completed analysis.

tools.name: compare_symbols
tools.description: Requires a SignalDock account connection. Read correlation, relative action and divergence analytics for two distinct securities.

tools.name: trading_day
tools.description: Read the public Trading Agent day feed or list available days. Public history starts November 1, 2026. Updates and fills are a narrative simulation; no orders are placed.

tools.name: read_archive
tools.description: List retained daily archive dates, or read a saved daily snapshot. Requires account research access. Does not regenerate reports.

tools.name: read_options_history
tools.description: Read a retained options-history snapshot using the identifier returned by options_question. Requires account research access.

tools.name: read_workspace
tools.description: Read your saved Rules, Notes and Trades from Playbook, or your saved Security Snapshot. Requires explicit Workspace consent. Trades are your written strategies, not brokerage executions. Never edits content or generates/emails reports.

tools.name: read_account_context
tools.description: Read your configured watchlists, symbols, service access and saved broker portfolio summary. Requires both Workspace and portfolio consent. Returns only the connected account owner’s data.

tools.name: read_portfolio
tools.description: List your saved and connected broker portfolios, read holdings, balances, saved metrics/account performance, or retained analysis history. Requires portfolio consent. Uses saved dated snapshots; never synchronizes brokers, imports records, places orders or generates a narrative. Follow nextCursor fo

tools.name: analyze_portfolio
tools.description: Run the existing Portfolio API for up to 50 supplied stock holdings with shares and optional per-share cost basis. Requires portfolio consent and existing service access/API allowance. Does not save a portfolio, place orders or synchronize a broker. Saved option holdings can be read with read_portfo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_report, trading_day, read_workspace · Private data: read_portfolio · Public sink: analyze_portfolio · Destructive: analyze_portfolio.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_report, trading_day, read_workspace · Private data: read_portfolio · Public sink: analyze_portfolio · Destructive: analyze_portfolio

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
